body_json.text: Last Sunday, I went to a famous flea market in Damascus. The weather was very nice and sunny, so many people were walking around. I wanted to buy a cheap lamp for my small bedroom. I saw many interesting old things like vintage books, clothes, and colorful pictures. Suddenly, I found a beautiful metal lamp on a wooden table. The friendly man asked for twenty euros, but I offered twelve euros. He smiled and accepted my offer. I also bought a small box for three euros. It was a great shopping day, and I walked back home happily with my nice things.

body_json.text: We had a very strange summer day in Aleppo yesterday. In the morning, the weather was extremely hot and sunny. The temperature was thirty-two degrees, so my friends and I went to a nearby lake. We were swimming in the cool water and eating strawberry ice cream. However, at three o'clock in the afternoon, the sky suddenly became very dark. Strong winds started blowing, and we heard loud thunder. It started raining heavily, so we ran quickly to a small coffee shop. We waited there for one hour until the storm finally stopped.

body_json.text: Two weeks ago, a new family moved into the apartment next to mine. They came from a small town in the south of Syria. I am very happy because I have wonderful neighbors now.

title: The First Day at Language School

body_json.text: I started my intermediate English course at a modern language institute last Monday. On the first day, I was very nervous because I did not know anyone. I entered the classroom at nine o'clock and met our teacher, Miss Sarah. She welcomed me warmly and gave me a big vocabulary textbook. There are ten other students in my class from different countries like Turkey and Brazil. We practiced speaking about our hobbies in pairs. The lesson was very interesting and active. Now, I feel more confident about learning English and making new international friends.
